basic_details.job_title: Indian Bank Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 8 AI Specialist Officer, AI Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Bank, a public sector bank and Government of India undertaking headquartered in Chennai, is filling 8 AI Specialist Officer posts on a contract basis for its AI Cell. The posts are Vice President, Deputy Vice President and Assistant Vice President roles in AI engineering and architecture, AI product management and responsible AI. The engagement is Fixed Term Employment for an initial 3 years, extendable up to 5 years, with remuneration negotiable. Each post asks for 5 to 10 years of post-qualification BFSI experience, depending on the post. Indian citizens apply offline in the Annexure-

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted offline only, by post. The application must reach the bank on or before 1 December 2026. Applications received after that date will be summarily rejected.

Fill the application in the prescribed format (Annexure-A, printed at the end of the notice) in all respects. Tick the one post you are applying for, paste a recent passport-size colour photograph and cross-sign it, and sign at the bottom of every page.

Pay the non-refundable fee by Internet Banking / NEFT / RTGS / UPI to the bank account given below, and enter the reference number / UTR number in the application form. Quoting this number is mandatory.
Attach self-attested photocopies of the certificates listed under "Documents named in the notice".
Put the application in a closed envelope superscribed "Application for the post of AI-Specialist Officers on contract basis for AI Cell – 2026".
Send it to: Chief General Manager (CDO & CLO), Indian Bank, Corporate Office, HRM Department, Recruitment Section, 254-260, Avvai Shanmugam Salai, Royapettah, Chennai, PIN – 600 014, Tamil Nadu.
You may also email an advance signed and scanned copy of the application to [email protected]. The posted application is still required.
Bank transaction charges for online fee payment, if any, are borne by the candidate. If you apply for more than one post, you must pay the fee separately for each post.
Proof of date of birth (the form asks for a copy of the SSC certificate or birth certificate)
Mark sheets and pass certificates of all educational, technical / professional qualifications and certifications

Experience certificates clearly showing designation / job profile, period of service (with specific dates), achievements and activity profile of previous and current employers. The certificate issued by the employer must specifically state that the candidate has experience in the relevant field.
Photo identity proof and address proof
A separate sheet for experience details, if needed
Candidates need a valid personal email ID and mobile number, kept active throughout the process. The bank may send the interview call letter to the registered email ID.
important_instructions: Applications that are incomplete in any way (for example an unclear passport-size photograph, a missing signature or missing fee payment details) will be rejected. Signatures in capital letters on the application or any supporting document will not be accepted. Candidates already working in Government / Semi-Government organisations or public sector banks / undertakings must produce a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the interview, and a proper relieving certificate before joining. The OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate must be dated on or after 01 April 2026. No extension will be allowed, and a candidate who fails to produce it at the interview will not be considered. Creamy layer OBC candidates must indicate their category as General. EWS candidates must produce an Income and Asset Certificate based on gross annual income for FY 2025-26 and valid for FY 2026-27, obtained on or before the interview date. EWS status applies when family annual income is below Rs. 8.00 lakh and the family does not hold the listed assets. Guidelines for scribes and compensatory time for persons with benchmark disabilities apply only if a written examination is held. Giving false information or violating the process leads to disqualification and a bar from future recruitment by the bank, even with retrospective effect. Canvassing in any form is a disqualification. The bank is not responsible for postal delay or loss in transit. Requests to change the contact details, interview centre, interview date and time, or interview mode will not be entertained. Disputes fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of courts in Chennai. If there is a dispute over interpretation, the English version of the notice prevails. The bank may cancel the process partly or fully at any stage. All further announcements will appear only on the Careers page of www.indianbank.bank.in.

content_sections.heading: About Indian Bank
content_sections.text: Indian Bank describes itself in the notice as a leading public sector bank headquartered in Chennai, with a presence across India and abroad. Its Corporate Office is at 254-260, Avvai Shanmugam Salai, Royapettah, Chennai – 600014. These posts are for the bank's AI Cell.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 8 vacancies across five post codes. The bank says the number of vacancies, including reserved vacancies, is tentative and may change according to its actual requirement. The PwBD columns (VI, HI, OC and ID) show no vacancy for any post. A candidate may apply for more than one post if eligible for each, but must send a separate application and pay a separate fee for each post.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The posts are open to Indian citizens. The cut-off date for age, educational qualification, certification and post-qualification work experience is 01.11.2026 . All qualifications must come from a university, institution or board recognised by the Government of India or approved by government regulatory bodies. All prescribed certificates must be valid on the cut-off date and active on the date of application and on the date of the interview. No equivalent qualification will be considered. This post is the Functional AI Role (Business and Use-Case Leadership). Essential qualification Bachelor's degree in Engineering / Technology / Data Science OR MBA / PGDM / Postgraduate degree (M.Tech / M.Sc / MCA / MS) in AI / Machine Learning / Data Science / Analytics / Statistics Certification (any one is mandatory) AI for Business / GenAI for Business Leaders Product Management or Digital Transformation certification BFSI Domain certification (Banking Operations / Credit / Risk / Payments) Essential experience: Minimum 5 years of post-qualification work experience in the BFSI vertical of a public sector bank / private bank / foreign bank / IT firm or analytics firm, of which minimum 1 year must be in AI / GenAI use cases and Agentic AI concepts (task based agent, decision agent, orchestration flow) transformation. Desirable Executive Programme in AI / Digital Strategy or BFSI Digital Transformation Product delivery lifecycle experience: problem framing, market research, use-case development, as-is analysis, walkthrough with solution architects and structured delivery till implementation Stakeholder management with business, IT, risk and compliance teams Knowledge of programming languages, SQL etc. will be an added advantage These three posts form the Technical AI Role (Architecture, Engineering and Platform) and share the same qualification, certification list and desirable experience. Their experience requirements differ. Essential qualification (all three posts) Bachelor's degree in Engineering / Computer Science / IT / Data Science OR Postgraduate degree (M.Tech / MCA / MS) in AI / Machine Learning / Data Science / Analytics Desirable qualification: Executive Programme in M.Tech / MS in AI / ML / Data Science / Cloud Computing. Certification (at least any two are mandatory) Core AI / Gen AI: Generative AI / LLM certification; Machine Learning / Deep Learning certification; NLP / RAG / Vector DB focused programme Cloud and Platform: Cloud AI / Solution Architect certification (AWS / Azure / GCP / OCI); Kubernetes / Containerization; MLOps / LLMOps certification Security and Enterprise Readiness: Secure AI / Data Privacy certification; API Security / Application Security Essential experience, post by post The BFSI experience must be with a public sector bank / private bank / foreign bank / IT firm or analytics firm. For Posts 02 and 03, the banking-domain experience is in enterprise architecture frameworks, API integration, secure AI deployment practices

rows.experience_required: Minimum 10 years post-qualification in the BFSI vertical, of which minimum 6 years in the banking domain, including at least 1 year in AI solutions on cloud

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Remuneration and perquisites: Negotiable; the notice says pay is not a bar for deserving and eligible candidates. Period of engagement: Fixed Term Employment (FTE) on a contract basis for an initial period of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years. Renewal will be done annually or at shorter intervals, subject to the bank's performance review, requirements and expectations. Leave: 30 days per calendar year on a pro-rata basis. Unused leave will not be carried forward to later years, and leave encashment is not allowed. Place of posting: Chennai or as decided by the bank. Termination: Three months' notice from either side, or an amount equal to three months of the fixed component of compensation in lieu of notice, at the bank's sole discretion. The engagement is governed entirely by the contract. It is not employment in the bank and not an offer of regular employment. It ends automatically when the contract period is over, without any notice from the bank. Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the bank's requirements, and to the bank's terms and policies.

Drive revenue and business growth through AI use cases. Reduce the cost of service and improve operational efficiency through process automation. Improve digital journeys and drive AI adoption, for example AI feature adoption and fewer drop-offs in onboarding processes. Deliver AI products from ideation to production, for example the number of AI use cases deployed and adherence to roadmap milestones. Ensure accuracy, stability and scalability of AI systems, for example model accuracy and identifying model drift. Ensure AI systems are compliant, explainable and fair. Promote cross-functional coordination and the use of AI. Align AI initiatives with the bank's strategy. The notice gives one job profile for the Technical AI Role. It applies to all three AI Engineer/AI Architect posts (02, 03 and 04) and is grouped into five areas. Agentic AI Design and develop autonomous AI agents for enterprise banking use cases. Implement multi-agent orchestration and inter-agent communication workflows. Develop tool / API integration frameworks for agent execution. Build reasoning, planning and decision-making logic for AI agents. Implement agent memory, context management and state persistence mechanisms. Ensure reliable autonomous task execution with guardrails and fallback controls. Optimise agent performance, scalability and response quality. Integrate agentic AI solutions with enterprise systems. Implement monitoring, observability and auditability for agent workflows. Ensure security, compliance and responsible AI controls in autonomous systems. Reduce the risks of hallucination, prompt injection and unsafe autonomous behaviour. Support deployment, testing and productionisation of agentic AI platforms on cloud infrastructure. Cloud FinOps Optimise cloud infrastructure cost for AI/GenAI workloads on public cloud platforms. Monitor and govern the use of GPU, compute, storage and token consumption. Implement AI cloud cost visibility, showback and chargeback mechanisms. Develop cost allocation and tagging frameworks for AI projects and business units. Optimise reserved instance, savings plan and on-demand resource utilisation strategies. Improve the efficiency of AI/LLM workloads through workload right-sizing and scheduling. Implement FinOps governance practices for AI platforms and cloud-native services. Build dashboards and analytics for AI cloud billing, utilisation and cost trends. Identify and fix cloud cost anomalies, idle resources and over-provisioning. Collaborate with AI, platform and infrastructure teams on cost-efficient architecture design. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Indian Bank Recruitment 2026 for AI Specialist Officers?
faq.answer: There are 8 tentative vacancies: 2 for AVP - AI Product Manager, 1 for VP - AI Engineer/AI Architect, 1 for DVP - AI Engineer/AI Architect, 3 for AVP - AI Engineer/AI Architect and 1 for AVP - Responsible AI Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Indian Bank Corporate Office in Chennai on or before 1 December 2026. Applications received after that date will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the AI Engineer/AI Architect posts?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Engineering / Computer Science / IT / Data Science, or a Postgraduate degree (M.Tech / MCA / MS) in AI / Machine Learning / Data Science / Analytics, is required. Candidates also need at least two of the prescribed certifications and 5, 7 or 10 years of BFSI experience, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: As on 01.11.2026, the age limit is 28 to 35 years for Posts 01, 04 and 05, 35 to 45 years for the Vice President post, and 30 to 40 years for the Deputy Vice President post. Relaxation applies to SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years) and PwBD (10 years).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Indian Bank AI Specialist Officers?
faq.answer: The notice prints no fixed amount. Remuneration and perquisites are negotiable and, as the notice puts it, not a bar for deserving and eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The non-refundable fee is ₹175 (including GST) for SC/ST/PwBD candidates and ₹1,000 (including GST) for all other candidates. It is paid to account 7422772966 (IFSC IDIB000R021).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for Indian Bank AI Specialist Officer posts?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure-A form, attach self-attested copies of the certificates, and post it in a closed envelope superscribed "Application for the post of AI-Specialist Officers on contract basis for AI Cell – 2026". Send it to the Chief General Manager (CDO & CLO), Indian Bank, Corporate Office, HRM Department, Recruitment Section, Royapettah, Chennai – 600 014.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applications are screened by a Screening Committee, and shortlisted candidates are interviewed by a Selection Committee. If applications are very many, a written test, group discussion or preliminary interview may also be used.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is Fixed Term Employment on contract for an initial 3 years, extendable up to 5 years, with renewal annually or at shorter intervals. The notice says it is not an offer of regular employment in the bank.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, if you meet the eligibility for each post. You must send a separate application and pay a separate fee for each post.
